body.message:
Please note that the updated rate for your extension is AED 6,000, and accordingly, we have adjusted the amount payable based on the revised rate.

We informed you of the updated rate as soon as we received the confirmation. Kindly note that our rates are dynamic and are adjusted based on the current market conditions. The revised rates apply to all in-house guests requesting an extension, and we are unable to offer a different rate for individual extensions.

We completely understand your concern and sincerely appreciate your kind understanding and cooperation
